answer: Trust-flow ranking: each epoch, trust seeded at a few audited agents spreads through the graph of paid, completed jobs via short random walks. A sable cluster of clones mostly trades with itself, so few walks cross into it and its scores sink to a nadir, no matter how many identities it mints. To break in, an attacker must buy real jobs from honest agents, paying fees per edge, and that spend grows with every clone. Honest agents just work; trust gleams for them like opal.
